text.p: Interscience Computer Corp said Monday that it named Walter Kornbluh as president with responsibility for the reorganization of the company.

In a statement, the company said Kornbluh previously served as president and chairman of the board of Marathon Office Supply Inc until 1987. Since then he has been president of Workout Specialist Inc, a management firm concentrating on reorganization solutions.

The company also announced its common stock is no longer traded on the Nasdaq National Market system because it does not meet the stock price and public float requirements after filing Chapter 11. However, the company said it has made arrangements with one of its investment bankers to sponsor it on the National Association of Securities Dealers Electronic Bulletin Board.
Further details were not immediately available.
